format:

      dark: darkly
      light: cosmo

    css: falsification-theme.css
    include-in-header:
      - _includes/color-scheme-meta.html

          <link rel="stylesheet" href="vignette-shared.css">
          <script src="vignette-shared.js"></script>
          <style>/* All styles in falsification-theme.css */</style>
          <script>
          if (!localStorage.getItem('quarto-color-scheme')) {
            document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bs-theme', 'dark');
          }
          // ── UI Controls: font size + dark/light toggle ──
          document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            var toolbar = document.createElement('div');
            toolbar.id = 'ui-controls';
            toolbar.innerHTML = '<button id="font-down" title="Decrease font">A-</button>' +
              '<button id="font-up" title="Increase font">A+</button>' +
              '<button id="theme-toggle" title="Toggle dark/light"></button>';
            document.body.appendChild(toolbar);

            // Font size
            var baseSize = parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('font-size-px') || '24');
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--base-font-size', baseSize + 'px');
            document.getElementById('font-up').addEventListener('click', function() {
              baseSize = Math.min(baseSize + 1, 32);
              document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--base-font-size', baseSize + 'px');
              localStorage.setItem('font-size-px', baseSize);
            });
            document.getElementById('font-down').addEventListener('click', function() {
              baseSize = Math.max(baseSize - 1, 12);
              document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--base-font-size', baseSize + 'px');
              localStorage.setItem('font-size-px', baseSize);
            });

            // Dark/light toggle
            var themeBtn = document.getElementById('theme-toggle');
            var isDark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-bs-theme') === 'dark';
            themeBtn.textContent = isDark ? '☀️' : '🌙';
            themeBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
              isDark = !isDark;
              document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bs-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
              themeBtn.textContent = isDark ? '☀️' : '🌙';
              localStorage.setItem('quarto-color-scheme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
            });
          });
          </script>

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)

# Path-checked store + utils (cwd is docs/ under quarto render, project
# root under tar_make). Same pattern as docs/falsification.qmd.
store_path <- if (dir.exists("_targets")) "_targets" else
  file.path(here::here(), "docs/_targets")
tar_config_set(store = store_path)

utils_path <- if (file.exists("vignette_utils.R")) "vignette_utils.R" else
  file.path(here::here(), "docs/vignette_utils.R")
source(utils_path)

# Verdict rule text and counts come from the one home (R/strategy_verdict.R).
sv_path <- if (file.exists("../R/strategy_verdict.R")) "../R/strategy_verdict.R" else
  file.path(here::here(), "R/strategy_verdict.R")
source(sv_path)

gh_issues <- "https://github.com/JohnGavin/historical/issues/"
```

::: {.callout-note .small}
**Where failures are recorded.** Every strategy's standing is computed once, by
`compute_strategy_verdict()` in `R/strategy_verdict.R`, from the same numbers the
[leaderboard](leaderboard.html) shows and the [falsification](falsification.html)
scorecard. The reasons, dates and issue links come from `data/strategy_register.csv`,
which holds only human judgement and no metric values. A strategy is listed here
until it earns **Keep**.
:::

# Failed and Watch

## Row

### {.tabset}

#### Strategies that are not Keep

```{r}
#| label: failures-table
sv <- safe_tar_read("strategy_verdict")
if (!is.null(sv)) {
  esc <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "", htmltools::htmlEscape(x))
  not_keep <- sv |>
    dplyr::filter(verdict != "Keep") |>
    dplyr::mutate(.vrank = match(verdict, rev(STRATEGY_VERDICT_LEVELS))) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.vrank, strategy_id)

  has_revisit <- "revisit_if" %in% names(not_keep) && any(!is.na(not_keep$revisit_if))
  pct <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "not computed", paste0(round(x * 100, 1), "%"))

  tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    Strategy = esc(not_keep$short_name),
    Verdict = sprintf("<strong>%s</strong>", esc(not_keep$verdict)),
    `Failing test(s)` = esc(not_keep$verdict_reason),
    `Net CAGR` = pct(not_keep$net_cagr),
    `DSR p` = ifelse(is.na(not_keep$dsr_pvalue_klogged), "not computed",
                     format(round(not_keep$dsr_pvalue_klogged, 3), nsmall = 3)),
    Detection = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(not_keep$detection_underpowered) ~ "not assessed",
      not_keep$detection_underpowered ~ "underpowered",
      TRUE ~ "powered"
    ),
    Falsification = ifelse(is.na(not_keep$fals_verdict), "not run", esc(not_keep$fals_verdict)),
    Reason = ifelse(is.na(not_keep$reason), "<em>none recorded</em>", esc(not_keep$reason)),
    `Decided on` = ifelse(is.na(not_keep$decided_on), "", esc(not_keep$decided_on)),
    Issue = ifelse(is.na(not_keep$issue), "",
                   sprintf("<a href='%s%s' target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'>#%s</a>",
                           gh_issues, not_keep$issue, not_keep$issue))
  )
  if (has_revisit) {
    tbl[["Revisit if"]] <- esc(not_keep$revisit_if)
  }

  n_failed <- sum(sv$verdict == "Failed")
  n_watch <- sum(sv$verdict == "Watch")
  n_noreason <- sum(not_keep$verdict == "Failed" & is.na(not_keep$reason))
  caption_text <- paste0(
    n_failed, " Failed and ", n_watch, " Watch of ", nrow(sv), " strategies. ",
    strategy_verdict_rule_text(),
    if (n_noreason > 0) paste0(" ", n_noreason, " Failed with no recorded reason (a defect).") else ""
  )

  DT::datatable(
    tbl,
    caption = hd_caption(caption_text),
    escape = FALSE,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE, autoWidth = FALSE,
      dom = "frtip",
      search = list(regex = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
      initComplete = DT::JS(
        "function(settings, json) {",
        "  var isDark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-bs-theme') === 'dark'",
        "    || document.body.classList.contains('dark-mode');",
        "  if (isDark) {",
        "    $(this.api().table().container()).css({'color': '#ddd', 'background-color': '#1a1a1a'});",
        "    $(this.api().table().header()).css({'color': '#ddd', 'background-color': '#222'});",
        "    $('input', this.api().table().container()).css({'color': '#ddd', 'background-color': '#333', 'border-color': '#555'});",
        "  }",
        "}"
      )
    )
  )
} else {
  cat("*`strategy_verdict` target not available. Run `tar_make()`.*")
}
```

#### How to Read This

Each row is a strategy whose computed verdict is **Failed** or **Watch**. **Failing
test(s)** names the rule branch that decided the verdict, or, for Watch, each Keep
criterion that is not met or could not be assessed (a missing input is reported, never
treated as a pass). **Reason** is the written judgement from the register, with its
evidence. **Detection** says whether the sample is long enough to tell the strategy's
Sharpe ratio from zero. **DSR p** is the deflated Sharpe ratio p-value, which corrects
for the number of strategies tried.

See the [leaderboard](leaderboard.html) for the full ranking and the
[falsification dashboard](falsification.html) for the alpha test.
